title: Educational Baby Activity Gym & Play Mat
description:
Colorful activity gym that grows with your baby! This play mat features hanging toys, a mirror, and various textures to stimulate sensory development.

Features:
- Large padded play mat (40x40 inches)
- Removable toy arch with 5 hanging toys
- Crinkle toys, rattles, and teething rings
- Baby-safe mirror for self-discovery
- Machine washable mat cover
- Tummy time pillow included

Perfect for newborns up to crawling age. Helps develop motor skills, hand-eye coordination, and visual tracking. Used for 6 months with one baby, thoroughly cleaned and sanitized. Mat and toys in excellent condition.
